# Neumorphism Theme

Soft UI / Neumorphism theme with raised and depressed elements.

## Install

```bash
npm install @intinyagroup/tokens@alpha
```

## Usage

```svelte
<script>
  import '@intinyagroup/tokens/neumorphism.css';
</script>
```

## Features

- Dual shadows (light + dark) for raised effect
- Soft, muted color palette
- Very rounded corners (1.5rem)
- Inset shadows for pressed state

## Dark Mode

```css
[data-ui-theme="neumorphism-dark"] {
  /* dark variant */
}
```
